caption: one week out: annular solar eclipse at 17.6° aquarius, feb 6 at 15:59 utc. greatest eclipse is over the south atlantic.

slides.headline: one week until the ring of fire *eclipse* in *aquarius*
an *annular* solar eclipse at the new moon
slides.body: the moon covers the middle of the sun and leaves a bright ring. greatest eclipse is over the south atlantic. check a local map, use eclipse glasses.

slides.headline: two eclipses, *two weeks* apart
slides.body: the solar eclipse in aquarius, then a penumbral lunar eclipse in virgo on feb 20. mercury stations retrograde in between, on feb 9.

slides.headline: a new moon with the *volume* up
slides.body: astrologers read solar eclipses as starts you didn't fully plan. in aquarius: friendships, freedom, the way you date.

rows.label: aquarius
rows.text: **your sign.** a new chapter, on purpose.

rows.label: leo
rows.text: the eclipse faces you. partnerships shift.

slides.headline: this week: *finish* one thing so there's room
slides.body: new moon, new deck. there's always an 11:11.
